record: The shops of the towns, in a browser: docs/TOWNS.md
note: Same computer only. A student pressed Go to town to trade on the family panel, read every shop of Gonzales and its prices in the popup, put a meal at the tavern paid in food on the list and sent the person; the keepers were in sight while the person was in Gonzales, and the meal is in the story. Since 2026-10-03 the same person bought a mule at the stock pens, led it home, saw it standing in the yard, and rode it to town chosen on its way card, drawn in its saddle (Claude's stand-in mule). Every other trade is proved in tests/shops.test.mjs and tests/mules.test.mjs; the load and the wagon in scripts/errand-browser-proof.mjs. No LAN or district claim.
checks: the family panel offers the street: "Choose what they should buy and sell at the shops in town, then send them with the list."

in Gonzales the popup lists 10 shops, every offer with its price: The store · Marta Ibarra; The blacksmith's · Josiah Pike; The gunsmith's · Tobias Rhine; The doctor's · Dr. Felipe Arocha; The tavern · Hannah Deering; The tanner's · Calvin Oakes; The wheelwright's · Rafael Cantú; The mill · Micajah Hobbs; The weaver's · Lucía Benavides; The stock pens · Anselmo Treviño

12 townspeople are in sight in Gonzales: Marta Ibarra, Josiah Pike, Anselmo Lozano, Ruth Crandall, Tobias Rhine, Dr. Felipe Arocha, Hannah Deering, Calvin Oakes, Rafael Cantú, Micajah Hobbs, Lucía Benavides, Anselmo Treviño
a meal at the tavern, paid in food, is in the family's story: "Polly ate at the tavern. Nobody there knew anything the family had not heard."

a mule is bought at the stock pens for 10 reales against a horse's 25 reales ("Rides the horse: 0 of 7 loads. Leads the new mule home on a halter."), led home drawn mule-walk-n, and stands in the yard drawn mule-idle, 29 px from the horse

the mule is chosen on its way card ("On the mule4 miles an hour · about 3.5 hours there · 2 loads of the 10 it carriesHardly tiring."), "Rides the mule: 2 of 10 loads, as you chose. The horse would be quicker.", and its rider is drawn in the saddle of mule-saddled-walk-s
